<module id="signal_generator">
    <description>Triangle Wave Signal Generator</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <output id="wave" width_description="[4:0]">Generated waveform signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="0">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="1">Transition state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state" width_description="[1:0]">State register.</reg>
        <reg id="wave" width_description="[4:0]">Waveform register.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State and waveform initialization
        if (~rst_n) begin
            state <= 0;
            wave <= 0;
        end else begin
            // State machine for waveform generation
            case(state)
                0: begin
                    // Increment waveform value
                    wave <= wave + 1;
                    
                    // Transition to next state if waveform reaches maximum value
                    if(wave == 31) begin
                        state <= 1;
                    end
                end
                
                1: begin
                    // Decrement waveform value
                    wave <= wave - 1;
                    
                    // Transition back to initial state if waveform reaches minimum value
                    if(wave == 0) begin
                        state <= 0;
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
